d: Pale powder-blue hair with blunt-cut bangs and wavy, shoulder-length locks is topped by a black peaked cap. The eyes are a vibrant magenta-purple shade with a sharp, focused expression, set upon a youthful and mature face. A slender build is partially visible beneath a dark navy blue military uniform with gold metallic accents. The only accessory is the black officer's cap featuring a gold emblem and gold trim.
